explanation: An attribute is a piece of information recorded about each entity instance. In a customer model, values like email or phone number are attributes because they describe each customer.

options.text: A fact stored about each customer, such as email or phone number
A rule that controls which users can view the table
A saved query used to display customer rows
A physical file that holds the table on disk

prompt: A small company wants to keep one table of its customers. Which statement best describes an attribute in that model?

explanation: An identifier must uniquely distinguish each entity instance. If one column is not enough, a combination of columns can serve as the identifier as long as the combination is unique for every row.

options.text: Use a value, or combination of values, that is unique for every row
Use any descriptive column, even if some rows repeat it
Use the column with the longest text values
Use a column only if it can contain duplicate values

prompt: A library system records one row per book copy. It needs a way to distinguish every row even when two copies share the same title and author. Which design best fits that need?

explanation: The rule says no single column is enough, but the combination of product_code and warehouse_code must be unique for each row. A composite primary key on those two columns matches that requirement.
prompt: A table named Product has columns (product_code, warehouse_code, description, price). Business rules say that the same product_code may appear in more than one warehouse, but the pair (product_code, warehouse_code) must identify each row exactly once. Which key definition best matches that rule in MySQL?

explanation: An identifier is the attribute or combination of attributes that uniquely distinguishes each instance of the entity. The other choices describe query convenience, volatility, or aggregate information rather than identification.

options.text: It is the attribute, or set of attributes, that uniquely separates one subscription from every other subscription
It is any attribute that happens to be frequently searched
It is the attribute that changes most often over time
It is a column that stores the total number of subscriptions

prompt: A startup is designing one table for its subscriptions. Each row represents one subscription. Which statement is the best model-level description of the table's identifier?
